query:
-- NE Senate: Both primaries called — promote to General
UPDATE senate_races 
SET status = 'General'
WHERE state_name = 'Nebraska';

-- Also check NE House races
SELECT state_name, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status
FROM house_races WHERE state_name IN ('Nebraska', 'West Virginia') ORDER BY state_name, district;
